selectedStyle.label: Inked Adventure Comic
selectedStyle.styleBlock: Hand-inked Western fantasy adventure comic: expressive variable-weight brush contours, simplified believable anatomy, bold silhouette design, flat opaque colors, two or three hard-edged shadow shapes, sparse dry-brush texture, and selective line detail at faces and focal materials. Mature, handmade, and readable; no painterly blending, no glossy 3D.
selectedStyle.defaultColorTreatment: Vivid but disciplined natural color: clear saturated local colors, strong warm/cool separation, and chromatic shadows. Selectively draw from jewel-toned teal, cobalt, jade, vermilion, amber, violet, and warm cream according to the actual subject and environment. Preserve believable material colors. No neon, psychedelic rainbow, forced uniform palette, destructive oversaturation, or washed-out sepia.
selectedStyle.referencePolicy: Use the style anchor for rendering language only and the closest approved category anchor for subject-scale material handling. Apply the canonical vivid color treatment by default, but do not inherit objects, layout, a reference image's specific palette, lighting, weather, or mood unless requested by the new asset.

calibration.firstPassFinding: Rejected: all three prose-only lanes converged on detailed painterly naturalism. Repetitive mail, fur, scale, roof, fence, and foliage detail overwhelmed the intended differences in shape simplification and value grouping.

lanes.label: More graphic
lanes.styleBlock: Semi-realistic fantasy illustration with clear cartoon-like shape design. Credible anatomy and perspective simplified into chunky readable silhouettes and decisive planar shapes. Matte opaque gouache-like painting with broad visible strokes and no enclosing contour line. Use firm focal edges, simplified secondary edges, and selected lost edges. Build most forms from two to four large value and color masses. Reserve small detail for the face or head, hands or claws, and one narrative accent. Materials read through shape breaks, grouped texture rhythms, and sparse highlights rather than individual hairs, scales, or pores. Handmade and mature, not cel-shaded, photorealistic, anime, or glossy 3D.
lanes.revisionStyleBlock: Graphic painted adventure realism: believable anatomy with clearly designed, mildly cartoonish silhouettes; chunky simplified planes; two to four broad flat value shapes; matte gouache brushwork; firm focal edges and soft secondary edges; grouped materials with almost no repeated microtexture. Mature fantasy illustration, with no enclosing outlines and no cel shading.

lanes.label: Balanced
lanes.styleBlock: Semi-realistic fantasy illustration with restrained cartoon-like shape design. Credible anatomy and perspective simplified into broad readable silhouettes and gently designed planes. Matte opaque gouache-like rendering with visible broad strokes and no enclosing outline. Edges are crisp at focal overlaps, softened within secondary forms, and lost into the background. Build most forms from three to five large value and color masses. Fine detail is reserved for the face or head, hands or claws, and one narrative accent. Materials are distinguished through plane changes, texture rhythm, and a few controlled highlights rather than hair-by-hair, scale-by-scale, or pore-level rendering. Polished but handmade; neither photorealistic, cel-shaded, anime, nor glossy 3D.
lanes.revisionStyleBlock: Painterly adventure realism: believable anatomy with gently cartoonish shape design; broad simplified planes; three to five clear value shapes; matte gouache brushwork; varied hard, soft, and lost edges; selective detail only at focal features; materials rendered by grouped texture and a few highlights. Mature fantasy illustration, with no enclosing outlines and no glossy realism.

lanes.label: More naturalistic
lanes.styleBlock: Semi-realistic fantasy illustration with subtle cartoon-like shape design. Credible anatomy and perspective with mildly simplified silhouettes and natural planar modeling. Matte opaque gouache-like painting with visible controlled strokes and no enclosing outline. Use crisp edges at focal overlaps, soft transitions across secondary forms, and lost edges into atmosphere. Build most forms from four to six broad value and color masses. Reserve fine detail for the face or head, hands or claws, and one narrative accent. Materials read through believable plane changes, restrained texture rhythms, and controlled highlights rather than microdetail. Handmade illustrative finish, not photorealistic, cel-shaded, anime, or glossy 3D.
lanes.revisionStyleBlock: Illustrated fantasy realism: believable anatomy with only subtle cartoon-like shape design; four to six broad value shapes; matte gouache brushwork; natural soft modeling with crisp focal edges; restrained material texture and no repeated microdetail. Mature hand-painted illustration, neither photorealistic nor glossy.

Asset type: Fantasy tabletop RPG house-style calibration revision
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and content/composition source only; do not inherit its rendering style
Primary request: Replace only the detailed painterly-naturalistic rendering with the style below
Style/medium: Illustrated fantasy realism: believable anatomy with only subtle cartoon-like shape design; four to six broad value shapes; matte gouache brushwork; natural soft modeling with crisp focal edges; restrained material texture and no repeated microdetail. Mature hand-painted illustration, neither photorealistic nor glossy.
Constraints: preserve subject identity, anatomy, pose, camera, scene contents, natural local palette, and neutral daylight; keep the complete subject safely inside the square; no fire, magic effects, dramatic sky, rim light, text, logo, watermark, border, or extra focal subjects
Warrior: Simplify mail into a grouped material pattern rather than individual rings.

qa.notes: Correct full-body anatomy and safe composition; grouped mail scallops remain somewhat repetitive.
